assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage protection, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All area, ratio, and footprint metrics are recomputed from the provisional site boundary and provisional three key-area polygons; they will be recalculated when official geometry is supplied.
assumptions.impact: Metrics are valid for intake review; they are not valid for statutory area or control-line claims.

assumptions.statement: Floor area ratio, building height, building density, setbacks, road redlines, and facility standards are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: These are reported as `status=unknown` in metrics.json; the proposal defers to the regulatory-plan process.

assumptions.statement: All spatial suggestions in this submission are concept proposals / reference schemes / material for professional teams to deepen. They do not replace formal planning, do not constitute government approval, and do not bypass statutory review.
assumptions.impact: All proposal language uses the three phrases above; no claims of approved plans, completed construction, or confirmed government commitments.

assumptions.statement: Each renewal project and AI scenario has an operator placeholder (TBD); the operator is to be designated by the future professional team and approved by the relevant government entity.
assumptions.impact: No claim is made that any operator is contracted or confirmed; the placeholder is preserved in compliance_matrix.json and proposal.md.
